newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nintendo shares fall on stronger yen.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo shares fall on stronger yen.

text.p: Shares of Nintendo Co Ltd, a major game machine and software maker, fell sharply on Monday, hurt by the yen's rally against the dollar, traders said.
By 0511 GMT, the share price had lost 440 yen to 8,910 yen on the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE). It briefly slipped as low as 8,850 yen. Turnover was 414,500 shares.

While other export-oriented firms, which had also been hit by the stronger yen, recouped part of their losses on bargain-hunting, buyers were taking a wait-and-see stance on Nintendo's shares ahead of its earnings report due out on Tuesday.
